thread:
Rina: Quick thread to finalize launch cadence for the tri-mode pages + webinar funnel. Need: 1) social launch posts, 2) technical benchmark narrative, 3) webinar speaker bullets + registration segmentation, 4) inbound routing to forms/CRM. 20m sync?
Jon: 👍 I can take social hooks and the short benchmark bullets. Dee: Ill draft the webinar blurb and speaker list. Marco: I'll do the SFDC mapping and inbound routing rules. Patti: Design needs hero lock + mobile CTA order.
Dee: Proposed webinar title: "Inference Ops: balancing latency, cost, and compliance". Speakers: Marco (product), Sam (platform eng), Priya (customer success). Slot: 2024-11-12 09:00 PT. Registration asks: role, monthly inference spend, region.
Jon: Social hooks (short, 2-3 options):
- "Ship production LLMs without building an infra team."
- "From prototype to 99th percentile reliability: how inference serving changes the game."
- "Lower per-token cost with smart caching and adaptive batching."
Pick two that land best.
Rina: Good. For the landing hero variants (A/B) we need different value props and CTAs. Please avoid the same phrasing as other assets.
Patti: Hero copy variants (new):
- Variant A: "Launch inference fast — tiny config, big throughput." CTA: "Start free trial"
- Variant B: "Take control of inference economics and reliability." CTA: "See pricing"
- Variant C: "Run private, hosted, or dedicated inference behind your controls." CTA: "Contact an engineer"
Marco: Routing rules for inbound signals -> next action (SFDC-based):
```
if utm_campaign contains "webinar": assign Lead.Owner = MarketingWebinarQueue, tag = "webinar_reg"
elif form_field.monthly_spend > 500: route -> AE team, lead_stage = SQL
elif question_text includes "compliance" or "SOC2" or "HIPAA": route -> EnterpriseOps@redwood, tag = "compliance_inquiry"
else: route -> ProductMarketing, nurture = 14 days
```
Jon: Benchmark bullets for social and the tech blog (concise):
- "Dedicated clusters: sustained 70ms p95 under 500 qps."
- "Hosted: median 90ms for typical web workloads; designed for burst-friendly scaling."
- "Real customer: 35% lower inference cost when using KV caching + request-level batching."
Make sure the blog has reproducible test notes.
Dee: Webinar blurb (for reg page):
> Join us for a 45-min walkthrough on operating inference at scale. We'll demo routing policies, autoscale behaviors, and a benchmark case study with a live Q&A. Ideal for platform engineers and product leads. Register and tell us your biggest challenge — we'll prioritize questions.
Rina: Good. For posts, include a link to the deep-dive benchmark blog + an invitation to the webinar. Use UTM params: utm_source=twitter, utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch, utm_medium=social. Marco: add SFDC campaign and track conversions to MQL.
Marco: Inbound form fields mapping to SFDC: name, email, company, role, monthly_spend_bucket, interest_page (hosted/dedicated/private), utm_campaign. Use a required field for interest_page so we can route immediately.
Patti: CTA order on mobile: move "Contact an engineer" above "See pricing" for Private page; data shows higher conversion when contact is frontloaded.
Rina: Deliverables & owners: Jon = 3 social hooks + benchmark bullets, Dee = webinar copy + speaker coordinator, Marco = routing rules + SFDC mapping, Patti = hero images + mobile CTA ordering. Deadline EOD Wed.
Jon: Dropping final social drafts and benchmark bullets by 3pm today.
Dee: I'll confirm speakers and draft speaker intros by EOD.
Marco: I'll push the routing automation snippet to ops-playbooks and share the SFDC field mapping spreadsheet. OpsBot: Reminder: campaign "tri-mode-launch-2024" created in SFDC.
Rina: Perfect. After Wed convergence we'll schedule a short review with Comms + SalesOps. :rocket:
